findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 5 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 26 questions numbered 1-26; by section: 5.1 2, 5.2 1, 5.2.1 3, 5.3 3, 5.4 3, 5.5 3, 5.6 3, 5.7 2, 5.8.1 2, 5.9 2, 5.10 2.

26 five-mark questions: the unit's proofs and derivations (Theorem 1, Theorem 2 forms and the normal-form reduction, Theorem 3, Theorems 4 and 5, Theorem 7 with its corollaries, the area formula, Theorem 8, the angle formula for a pair of lines) and its main problem types (forms of a line, medians/altitudes/right bisectors with their common points, concurrency, families of lines, angles of a triangle, area and collinearity, pairs of lines, applications) with new data. Book corrections followed (sin(theta) = -a/(+-sqrt(a^2+b^2)) in the symmetric form, the 'to' slope first in Theorem 7, '= 0' in the Theorem 4 determinant, m1 m2 x^2 in the homogeneous check). Every step was checked by computation (sympy, check5.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
